Based on first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the frustrated V sublattice naturally stabilizes a robust vortex or anti-vortex antiferromagnetic ground state, whose total energy is substantially lower than all other configurations. In addition, the Heisenberg model analysis show strong constraints on the ground state magnetic configuration, such that fixing spin configuration of 1 triangle propagates and fixes all others. The vortex or anti-vortex phase hosts electronic structures reminiscent of kagome metals, including Dirac-like band crossings, van Hove singularities, and flat bands near the Fermi level. Owing to the noncollinear spin texture and quasi-two-dimensional magnetic character, the N\'eel temperature exhibits an extremely weak dependence on both the magnitude and direction of external magnetic fields, consistent with experimental observations. For Cs-based compound, the ground state band structure is metallic with 6 Weyl points in the BZ; while for the Rb-based compound, spin--orbit coupling opens an approximately 27-meV gap at ambient pressure due to the lifted C$_3$ symmetry. Our results establish $A_3$V$_9$Te$_{13}$ as a promising platform for studying frustration-driven chiral magnetism and its interplay with topological electronic states.

AI.tldr: 第一性原理计算表明，A3V9Te13（A=Cs, Rb）中阻挫 V 亚晶格稳定涡旋/反涡旋反铁磁基态，并展现类 kagome 电子结构、拓扑能带特征及对磁场极不敏感的磁性。
AI.motivation: 探索几何阻挫、磁性、关联电子态以及拓扑电子态之间的相互作用，并突破常规 kagome 体系的限制。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理计算，结合 Heisenberg 模型分析磁基态约束，并考虑非共线自旋织构与自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）研究电子结构和磁热性质。
AI.result: 涡旋/反涡旋反铁磁基态总能量显著低于其他构型；固定一个三角形的自旋构型会传播并固定其余所有三角形。该相在费米能级附近具有 Dirac 型能带交叉、van Hove 奇点和平带。Néel 温度对外场大小和方向依赖极弱，与实验一致。Cs 基化合物基态为金属，布里渊区中有 6 个 Weyl 点；Rb 基化合物因 C3 对称性破缺，SOC 在常压下打开约 27 meV 能隙。
AI.conclusion: A3V9Te13 是研究阻挫驱动手性磁性及其与拓扑电子态相互作用的理想平台。

title: Pt-induced semimetallic transport and enhanced thermoelectric response in the half-Heusler alloy YNi_{0.5}Pt_{0.5}Bi
summary: Half-Heusler alloys provide a versatile platform for tuning electronic and thermal transport through chemical substitution. Here, we investigate the thermoelectric and magnetotransport properties of spark-plasma-sintered YNi_{0.5}Pt_{0.5}Bi. Partial substitution of Ni by Pt drives YNiBi toward semimetallic transport, characterized by hole-dominated conduction, a low Hall carrier concentration of $\mathrm{1.9 \times 10^{19} cm^{-3}}$, and a sizeable nonsaturating magnetoresistance of 18$\%$ at 300 K under 14 T. Compared with YNiBi, Pt alloying increases the room-temperature Seebeck coefficient from approximately 90 to 130 $\mathrm{\mu V K^{-1}}$, while reducing the thermal conductivity to 3.15 $\mathrm{W m^{-1} K^{-1}}$. Single-parabolic-band analysis indicates an enhanced carrier effective mass, resulting in a room-temperature power factor of 13.7 $\mathrm{\mu W cm^{-1} K^{-2}}$ and a figure of merit ($zT$= 0.13). First-principles calculations further show a Pt-induced closing of the electronic band gap and a low density of states near the Fermi level, consistent with the experimentally observed semimetal-like transport. These results demonstrate that Ni/Pt alloying provides an effective route for simultaneously tuning the electronic, magnetotransport, and thermoelectric properties of YNiBi-based half-Heusler compounds.

AI.tldr: 研究了放电等离子烧结制备的YNi0.5Pt0.5Bi半赫斯勒合金，发现Ni/Pt合金化使YNiBi转向半金属输运，并同时调控其热电与磁输运性能：300 K、14 T下非饱和磁阻为18%，Seebeck系数从约90提升至130 μV K−1，热导率降至3.15 W m−1 K−1，zT达0.13。
AI.motivation: 半赫斯勒合金可通过化学取代灵活调控电子与热输运。本文旨在探究Ni位Pt部分取代对YNiBi基化合物的热电和磁输运性质的影响。
AI.method: 采用放电等离子烧结制备YNi0.5Pt0.5Bi；测量其热电与磁输运性质；用单抛物带模型分析载流子有效质量；结合第一性原理计算电子结构，解释实验观察到的半金属型输运。
AI.result: Pt取代Ni后，YNiBi基材料呈现空穴主导的半金属输运，Hall载流子浓度为1.9×10^19 cm−3，300 K、14 T下磁阻为18%且不饱和。相比YNiBi，室温Seebeck系数由约90增至130 μV K−1，热导率降至3.15 W m−1 K−1。单抛物带分析表明载流子有效质量增强，室温功率因子为13.7 μW cm−1 K−2，zT=0.13。第一性原理计算显示Pt诱导带隙闭合，费米能级附近态密度较低，与半金属型输运一致。
AI.conclusion: Ni/Pt合金化是同时调控YNiBi基半赫斯勒化合物电子、磁输运和热电性能的有效途径。

title: Discontinuous-Property Mechanical Metamaterials: A Framework for Discontinuous Lattice Dynamics
summary: Discontinuity, as the extreme limit of nonlinearity, is common in macroscopic continuum systems. This work introduces discontinuous-property mechanical metamaterials (DPMMs) as a prototype for establishing a geometric-mechanics framework for discontinuous lattice systems. We extend band theory to systems with complementary constraints through geometric regularization and analyze modal discontinuities. By analyzing its static, modal, and transient responses, we validated discontinuous stiffness and Poisson's ratio, alongside intense nonlinear wave mixing and mode conversion. A proof-of-concept experiment demonstrates the practical feasibility of implementing DPMMs. This work characterizes discontinuous lattice systems through the intuitive DPMM concept and provides a practical framework to harness sharp transitions in mechanical metamaterials for nonlinear wave manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出不连续属性机械超材料（DPMMs），为不连续晶格系统建立几何-力学框架，并通过理论、数值与验证实验展示其在非线性波调控中的应用。
AI.motivation: 不连续性作为非线性的极端极限，在宏观连续系统中普遍存在，但针对不连续晶格系统仍缺乏统一的几何-力学描述和实用设计框架。
AI.method: 引入DPMMs作为原型；通过几何正则化将能带理论推广至具有互补约束的系统，分析模态不连续性；结合静态、模态和瞬态响应分析，并开展概念验证实验。
AI.result: 验证了不连续刚度和泊松比，观察到强烈的非线性波混频与模式转换；概念验证实验证明DPMMs在实际中可行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以直观的DPMM概念刻画不连续晶格系统，并提供利用机械超材料中尖锐转变进行非线性波调控的实用框架。

title: All-temperature superfluidity in two dimensions
summary: In local theories with short-range interactions, continuous symmetries cannot be spontaneously broken in two spatial dimensions at nonzero temperature. $\mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric models instead admit a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) phase with quasi-long-range order and nonzero phase stiffness, which is normally destroyed at high temperatures by vortex proliferation. Here, we show that a BKT phase, and with it superfluidity, can persist to arbitrarily high temperatures. Using the large-$N$ expansion, we study a $(2+1)$-dimensional quantum field theory in which a complex scalar is coupled to the critical $\mathrm{O}(N)$ model. At the biconical fixed point, where the inter-sector coupling is negative, the thermal effective potential has a circle of minima with nonzero $\mathrm{U}(1)$ amplitude. Integrating out the gapped fluctuations yields an effective theory for the compact phase mode at distances large compared to $1/T$. Since temperature is the only scale at the fixed point, the phase stiffness grows linearly with temperature, with a proportionality factor that scales linearly with $N$ and is fixed entirely by the fixed point. This renders vortex operators irrelevant for sufficiently large $N$. We further show that the vortex fugacity is exponentially small in $N$.

AI.tldr: 在(2+1)维复标量与临界O(N)模型耦合的大N理论中，双锥固定点可实现BKT相和超流持续到任意高温：相位刚度随温度线性增长，涡旋算符在大N下无关，涡旋逸度指数小。
AI.motivation: 二维有限温下连续对称通常不能自发破缺，U(1)模型的BKT相也一般因高温涡旋增殖而被破坏；本文旨在寻找使BKT相和超流在任意高温下仍能存活的新机制。
AI.method: 采用大N展开研究(2+1)维量子场论，其中复标量耦合到临界O(N)模型；聚焦部门耦合为负的双锥固定点，计算有限温热有效势，积分掉有能隙涨落，得到距离远大于1/T时紧致相位模式的有效理论，并分析相位刚度与涡旋算符。
AI.result: 在双锥固定点，热有效势出现U(1)振幅非零的极小圆；因温度是固定点唯一标度，相位刚度线性随温度增长，比例系数线性依赖于N并由固定点完全确定。大N下涡旋算符变为无关，且涡旋逸度随N指数小，因此BKT相与超流可延续到任意高温。
AI.conclusion: 该(2+1)维固定点支持一种由大N机制稳定的BKT相和超流，其高温行为不受常规涡旋增殖破坏，可一直持续到任意高温度。

title: Modified anisotropy and distinct phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic $S=1$ triangular-lattice antiferromagnet $\mathrm{Rb_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$
summary: The triangular-lattice antiferromagnet serves as a benchmark platform for realizing exotic quantum phases, in which magnetic anisotropy plays an essential role. In this work, we report modified magnetic anisotropy and phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic $S=1$ triangular-lattice antiferromagnet $\mathrm{Rb_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$, compared with those of its isostructural analog $\mathrm{K_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$. The magnetic susceptibility of $\mathrm{Rb_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$ exhibits an easy-axis anisotropy with $g_c > g_{ab}$, opposite to the easy-plane anisotropy observed in $\mathrm{K_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$. The single N\'eel transition observed at zero field splits into two transitions at around 10~T, and a magnetization plateau is observed between 21~T and 37~T for both out-of-plane ($H\parallel c$) and in-plane ($H\parallel ab$) field directions in $\mathrm{Rb_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$. We construct magnetic phase diagrams that are distinct between $\mathrm{Rb_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$ and $\mathrm{K_2Ni(SeO_3)_2}$. These findings highlight the sensitivity of field-induced magnetic phase behavior to anisotropy in nearly isotropic triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比同构三角晶格反铁磁体 Rb2Ni(SeO3)2 与 K2Ni(SeO3)2，发现前者表现为易轴各向异性，并具有不同的场诱导相图与磁化平台。
AI.motivation: 三角晶格反铁磁体是研究奇异量子相的基准平台，其中磁各向异性起关键作用；作者希望理解近各向同性体系中各向异性如何调控场诱导磁相行为。
AI.method: 对近各向同性 S=1 三角晶格反铁磁体 Rb2Ni(SeO3)2 进行磁化率测量，并与同构类似物 K2Ni(SeO3)2 对比；结合不同场方向下的磁化行为构建磁相图。
AI.result: Rb2Ni(SeO3)2 的磁化率显示易轴各向异性（g_c > g_ab），与 K2Ni(SeO3)2 的易面各向异性相反；零场单一 Néel 相变在约 10 T 分裂为两个相变，并在 21–37 T 之间、H||c 和 H||ab 时均出现磁化平台；两者磁相图不同。
AI.conclusion: 在近各向同性三角晶格反铁磁体中，场诱导磁相行为对磁各向异性高度敏感，通过同构取代调控各向异性可改变相变与磁化平台等物性。

title: Plasmon Collapse in a Directional Strange Metal
summary: Strange metals are widespread in strongly correlated quantum matter and closely intertwined with high-temperature superconductivity and quantum criticality, yet their microscopic charge dynamics remain fundamentally unresolved. Whether well-defined collective modes survive in an incoherent electronic fluid or dissolve into overdamped continua remains intensely debated. Here, employing high-momentum-resolution inelastic electron scattering complemented by direction-resolved transport, we show that the van der Waals compound $\mathrm{MoOCl}_2$, a "bad" metal known to host unusually "good" plasmons, exhibits a striking dichotomy in electronic coherence and charge dynamics. Transport reveals coherent Fermi liquid behavior along one in-plane crystallographic axis and an incoherent strange metal response along the orthogonal axis. This dichotomy extends directly to the charge response. The Fermi liquid direction supports a well-defined, long-lived plasmon, whereas the strange metal direction exhibits an overdamped excitation that progressively loses its collective character with increasing momentum. Beyond a critical momentum ($q_c$ $\approx$ 0.008 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}^{-1}$), the mode undergoes a reversal into negative dispersion and ultimately collapses into a broad, nearly featureless continuum with a robust high-energy boundary ($E_c$ $\approx$ 1.75 eV). Remarkably, thickness-dependent measurements show that both $q_c$ and $E_c$ remain nearly unchanged despite substantial modifications of Coulomb screening, revealing them as intrinsic scales of incoherent charge density fluctuations. These results establish a unique single-material platform in which coherent and incoherent electronic states are partitioned into in-plane orthogonal channels, and demonstrate that incoherent electronic fluids retain intrinsically structured charge dynamics beyond the quasiparticle paradigm.

AI.tldr: 在范德华坏金属MoOCl2中，面内正交晶轴分别呈现费米液体与奇异金属行为，并对应相干长寿命等离激元与过阻尼电荷激发；后者超过临界动量后反转为负色散并坍缩为具有约1.75 eV稳健边界的连续谱。
AI.motivation: 奇异金属广泛存在于强关联量子物质中，并与高温超导和量子临界性密切相关，但其微观电荷动力学仍未解决。核心争论是：在非相干电子液体中，明确集体模式能否存活，还是会溶解为过阻尼连续谱。
AI.method: 结合高动量分辨非弹性电子散射与方向分辨输运测量，研究范德华化合物MoOCl2，并进行厚度依赖测量以检验库仑屏蔽变化的影响。
AI.result: 输运显示沿一个面内晶轴为相干费米液体行为，沿正交轴为非相干奇异金属行为。电荷响应同样二分：费米液体方向有明确、长寿命等离激元；奇异金属方向为过阻尼激发，随动量增加逐渐失去集体特征。超过qc≈0.008 Å^-1后，模式反转为负色散，最终坍缩为宽且近乎无特征的连续谱，并具有稳健高能边界Ec≈1.75 eV。厚度依赖测量表明，尽管库仑屏蔽显著改变，qc与Ec几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: MoOCl2建立了单一材料平台，将相干与非相干电子态分置于面内正交通道，并表明非相干电子液体在准粒子范式之外仍保留内禀结构化的电荷动力学。

title: Non-equilibrium Muon Dynamics Imitating Fractional Spin Excitations in a Quantum Spin Chain
summary: Fractional spin excitations in low-dimensional and frustrated magnets are commonly associated with sporadic spin fluctuations, as observed in quantum spin liquids, spin ices, and other complex magnetic states. In this study, we investigate the spin dynamics in the amplitude-modulated magnetic ground state of AgCuVO$_4$, a spin-1/2 chain compound with competing intrachain interactions, by muon spectroscopy. Our data reveal a Gaussian decay of muon polarization that remains remarkably resilient against applied magnetic fields---a behavior often interpreted as evidence of emergent sporadic spin dynamics. However, density functional theory calculations of muon stopping sites and their quadrupolar level-crossing resonance spectra suggest an alternative mechanism: a two-state model where the muon randomly hops between two nearby sites, eventually equilibrating across both on a microsecond timescale via quantum delocalization. These findings provide a microscopic explanation for the field-resilient muon polarization and indicate that such behavior may not always stem from intrinsic spin fluctuations, but can also arise from non-equilibrium muon dynamics.

AI.tldr: 在自旋-1/2链化合物AgCuVO$_4$中，μ子谱学观测到的磁场不敏感高斯衰减并非一定源于本征分数自旋涨落，而可由μ子在两个近邻停驻位点间的量子跳跃与平衡化解释。
AI.motivation: 低维与阻挫磁体中的分数自旋激发常表现为间歇性自旋涨落，但μ子谱学中类似信号可能被误判为本征自旋动力学，因此需要甄别μ子自身动力学贡献。
AI.method: 结合μ子自旋谱学测量、密度泛函理论计算μ子停驻位点，以及四极能级交叉共振谱分析，研究AgCuVO$_4$振幅调制磁基态中的自旋动力学与μ子行为。
AI.result: μ子极化呈现高斯衰减，且在外加磁场下异常稳定；DFT与共振谱支持双位点模型：μ子在两个近邻位点间随机跳跃，并在微秒时间尺度上通过量子离域在两个位点间达到平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为磁场稳定的μ子极化提供了微观机制，表明此类行为不一定来自本征自旋涨落，也可能源于非平衡μ子动力学，提示解释μ子谱学信号时需谨慎区分。

title: Flat-band ferrimagnetism in the edge-centered honeycomb antiferromagnet: From harmonic flat magnon to broad continuum
summary: One of the most striking aspects of a flat band is not merely its lack of dispersion, but that it reduces the single-particle kinetic energy to a very small scale, allowing interaction effects to become the dominant energy scale in the low-energy physics. This picture has underpinned concepts such as flat-band ferromagnetism, flat-band superconductivity, and localized magnons. A more fundamental question, however, remains. Flat bands belong to the language of single-particle or linear-spin-wave physics; whether they survive as protected sharp excitations in a genuine many-body quantum magnet, or merely provide a skeleton of spectral weight left by the noninteracting picture, remains unclear. We study the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the edge-centered honeycomb lattice to examine this question. In contrast to flat bands in geometrically frustrated magnets such as kagome, this lattice has a 2:3 sublattice imbalance that renders the intersublattice coupling matrix rectangular, whose null space gives rise to a flat band at the single-particle level. The same imbalance stabilizes a ferrimagnetic ground state through the Lieb--Mattis theorem and leads to an edge-site-localized flat magnon in linear spin-wave theory. Combining linear spin-wave theory, sign-problem-free stochastic series expansion quantum Monte Carlo, and stochastic analytic continuation, we find that quantum fluctuations transform this harmonic flat mode into a broad continuum whose centroid is about 1.55J and nearly dispersionless along the high-symmetry path. Sublattice imbalance thus offers an unfrustrated route that unifies flat bands and ferrimagnetism, and suggests that flat-band geometry organizes many-body spectral weight rather than giving rise to a protected quasiparticle.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究边缘中心蜂窝晶格上的自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁体，发现线性自旋波中的平带磁振子在量子涨落下并不作为受保护准粒子存在，而是展宽为质心约1.55J、沿高对称路径近无色散的连续谱。
AI.motivation: 平带不仅缺乏色散，还会把单粒子动能压低到很小尺度，使相互作用效应主导低能物理，这支撑了平带铁磁、平带超导和局域磁振子等概念。但平带属于单粒子或线性自旋波语言，其在真实多体量子磁体中是否仍作为受保护尖锐激发存在尚不清楚。
AI.method: 研究边缘中心蜂窝晶格上的自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁体，结合线性自旋波理论、无符号问题随机级数展开量子蒙特卡洛以及随机解析延拓。该晶格具有2:3子晶格失衡，使子晶格间耦合矩阵为矩形，其零空间在单粒子层面产生平带；同一失衡通过Lieb-Mattis定理稳定亚铁磁基态，并在线性自旋波理论中给出边缘位点局域平磁振子。
AI.result: 量子涨落将这一谐波平模转变为宽连续谱，其质心约为1.55J，并且沿高对称路径几乎无色散。
AI.conclusion: 子晶格失衡提供了一条非阻挫路径，将平带与亚铁磁性统一起来；结果表明平带几何更可能是组织多体谱权，而不是产生受保护的准粒子。

title: Probing Deconfined Quantum Criticality Point on a Digital Quantum Computer
summary: A deconfined quantum critical point (DQCP) is a continuous transition between ordered phases with unrelated broken symmetries, beyond the Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm. In one dimension, such a transition between a $z$-polarized ferromagnet (zFM) and a valence-bond solid (VBS) is well established numerically in a frustrated spin-$1/2$ chain. Here we ask whether a superconducting quantum processor can resolve this transition and its signatures despite finite-size effects and device noise. The ground states are prepared by ancilla-projected quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE), whose exact target states are compressed by tensor-network optimization into shallow depth quantum circuits. The hardware data distinguish the phases through their order parameters, spin and dimer correlations, structure factors, correlation ratios, and snapshot distributions. The crossing of the order parameters locates the transition, and its finite-size extrapolation lies close to the thermodynamic-limit value obtained from large-scale numerics. A noise model based on the device calibration accounts quantitatively for the reduced amplitudes measured on hardware. Our findings demonstrate that a Landau-forbidden transition between competing orders can be resolved on current quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 利用超导量子处理器结合量子虚时间演化与张量网络电路压缩，在有限尺寸和器件噪声下成功分辨了一维 zFM-VBS 去禁闭量子临界点及其签名。
AI.motivation: 去禁闭量子临界点（DQCP）超越 Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson 范式，描述对称性无关的有序相之间的连续转变；一维阻挫自旋-1/2链中 zFM-VBS 转变已被数值确立，但能否在含噪量子硬件上解析该转变尚不清楚。
AI.method: 通过 ancilla 投影的量子虚时间演化（QITE）制备基态，并用张量网络优化将精确目标态压缩为浅层量子线路；在超导量子处理器上测量序参量、自旋与二聚化关联、结构因子、关联比和快照分布，同时建立基于设备校准的噪声模型。
AI.result: 硬件数据能够区分 zFM 与 VBS 相；序参量交叉定位了转变点，其有限尺寸外推接近大规模数值得到的热力学极限值；基于校准的噪声模型定量解释了硬件上观测到的振幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，当前量子处理器已能够解析竞争有序相之间的 Landau 禁戒转变。

title: Putting a Temperature on Electron Correlation
summary: It is common wisdom that a better understanding of how to quantify electron correlation should lead to more efficient treatments of the correlation problem. Here, we not only substantiate this view but turn it into a concrete, systematic framework for ground states. Since prominent correlation measures such as the nonfreeness depend only on the one-particle reduced density matrix, modeling the correlation energy as a function of such a measure naturally places the framework within reduced density matrix functional theory, while keeping the cost at mean-field level. Strikingly, the variable conjugate to the measure emerges as a ``correlation temperature'', thereby connecting correlation measures, functional theory, and effective temperatures. The framework rationalizes methods such as i-DMFT, and we illustrate its key concepts analytically for the Hubbard dimer and numerically for small molecular systems. This brings a fundamental question within reach: how much of the correlation problem can be solved at mean-field cost?

AI.tldr: 该工作将电子关联的量化转化为一个系统的基态框架：以仅依赖单粒子约化密度矩阵的关联度量（如 nonfreeness）为变量建模关联能，在保持平均场计算成本的同时，把关联度量、约化密度矩阵泛函理论和有效温度联系起来。
AI.motivation: 普遍认为，更好地理解如何量化电子关联应能带来更高效的关联问题处理；作者希望把这一观点落实为具体、系统的基态理论框架。
AI.method: 在约化密度矩阵泛函理论（RDMFT）框架内，将关联能表示为仅依赖单粒子约化密度矩阵的关联度量（如 nonfreeness）的函数，因此计算成本保持在平均场水平；引入与该度量共轭的变量，发现其表现为“关联温度”；据此合理化 i-DMFT 等方法，并用 Hubbard 二聚体进行解析说明、对小分子体系进行数值验证。
AI.result: 建立了一个系统框架，证实关联度量可指导更高效的关联处理；揭示共轭变量为“关联温度”，从而连接关联度量、泛函理论和有效温度；可解释 i-DMFT，并在 Hubbard 二聚体和小分子体系上展示了核心概念。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使一个基本问题触手可及：关联问题中有多少可以在平均场成本下解决。

title: A rigid commensurate host and a defect that switches: vacancies in the frustrated alternating spin-(1, 1/2) Heisenberg chain
summary: The alternating spin-$(1,\tfrac12)$ Heisenberg chain with a frustrating next-nearest-neighbor coupling $J_2$ loses its Lieb--Mattis moment through a discontinuous transition to a singlet whose nature was left open. Using an SU(2)-symmetric density-matrix renormalization group, in which the total spin is a quantum-number label, we identify that phase and follow a single vacancy through it. The total spin collapses directly from $S=L/4$ to $S=0$, with no partially polarized window. The singlet phase is critical: its singlet--triplet gap closes as $1/L$, its entanglement entropy grows logarithmically with a central charge $c\simeq1.8$, and its modulation wavevector, extrapolated from $L=80$ to $200$, is commensurate at $3\pi/4$ and independent of $J_2$ to $5\times10^{-5}$. Removing the central $S=1$ site switches the ground state of the doped chain from a triplet to a singlet at $J_2^{\ast}=0.3068(3)$, where the host shows no feature; the triplet is not bound to the vacancy but spread over one of the two segments it leaves. The transmission of correlations through the vacancy saturates at a finite value below $J_2^{\ast}$, $T(\infty)=0.102(15)$ and $0.036(9)$ at $J_2=0.28$ and $0.30$, and the cut-chain law $T\propto L^{-1}$ is excluded on both sides. We also show that the longitudinal correlator is not an observable in a triplet sector.

AI.tldr: 利用SU(2)对称DMRG确定了阻挫交替自旋(1,1/2) Heisenberg链中经不连续相变进入的临界单态相，并追踪单个空位揭示掺杂链的三重态-单态切换及非切链式关联透射。
AI.motivation: 该模型在次近邻耦合J2驱动下通过不连续转变失去Lieb-Mattis矩，但终态单态的本质、是否出现部分极化窗口以及空位/掺杂物理此前仍未明确。
AI.method: 采用以总自旋为量子数标签的SU(2)对称密度矩阵重整化群，系统追踪单空位（移除中心S=1格点）并计算基态、自旋隙、纠缠熵、调制波矢和关联透射。
AI.result: 总自旋从S=L/4直接塌缩到S=0，无部分极化窗口；单态相临界：singlet-triplet隙按1/L关闭，纠缠熵对数增长，中心荷c≈1.8，调制波矢从L=80外推到200为3π/4且对J2不敏感至5×10^{-5}；移除中心S=1格点后，掺杂链基态在J2*=0.3068(3)由三重态变为单态，而宿主无对应特征；三重态不束缚于空位，而分布在空位留下的一个片段上；空位关联透射在J2*以下饱和，T(∞)=0.102(15)和0.036(9)分别在J2=0.28和0.30，排除切链律T∝L^{-1}；纵向关联函数在三重态扇区中不是可观测量。
AI.conclusion: 该不连续转变后的单态相是临界相，而非简单有隙相；单空位可作为探测其临界性和非局域自旋结构的局部杂质，且其关联透射呈有限饱和而非切链式，纵向关联在三重态扇区中不可观测。

title: Unique Charge-density-wave Order and Fluctuation-induced Phonon Softening in the Optimally-doped Trilayer Cuprate Bi$_2$Sr$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{10+\delta}$
summary: Charge-density-wave (CDW) order is a ubiquitous feature of cuprate superconductors that competes with superconductivity. However, its behavior remains poorly understood in trilayer compounds, which contain the optimal number of CuO$_2$ layers for superconductivity. Here, we report Cu $L_3$- and O $K$-edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) measurements of optimally-doped Bi$_{2}$Sr$_{2}$Ca$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{10+\delta}$ (Bi2223), the trilayer cuprate with the highest superconducting transition temperature ($T_c$) among Bi-based cuprates. We observe CDW order with a single in-plane wavevector of ${\bm q}_{\text{CDW}} = (0.25, 0)$, demonstrating that a coherent CDW order is formed across the trilayers. We also resolve CDW fluctuations emanating from the static order, whose profiles differ between the Cu $L_3$ and O $K$ edges. The phonon softening occurs where these CDW fluctuations interact with the phonon branch, indicating that the RIXS phonon anomaly is driven by the coupling between CDW fluctuations and the phonon branch.

AI.tldr: 利用Cu L3边和O K边RIXS研究了最佳掺杂三层铜氧化物Bi2223中的电荷密度波，发现单一面内波矢(0.25,0)的相干CDW序以及由CDW涨落与声子耦合驱动的声子反常。
AI.motivation: CDW序普遍存在于铜氧化物超导体中并与超导竞争，但在具有最佳超导CuO2层数的三层化合物中其行为仍理解不足。
AI.method: 对最佳掺杂Bi2Sr2Ca2Cu3O10+δ（Bi2223）进行Cu L3边和O K边共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）测量。
AI.result: 观察到q_CDW=(0.25,0)的CDW序，表明跨三层形成相干CDW序；解析出从静态序发出的CDW涨落，其剖面在Cu L3边与O K边不同；声子软化发生在CDW涨落与声子支相互作用处。
AI.conclusion: RIXS声子反常由CDW涨落与声子支耦合驱动；三层铜氧化物中可形成跨层相干CDW序，为理解其与超导的竞争提供了依据。

title: $d$-wave superconductivity in quintuple-layer bulk superconductor La$_6$Ni$_5$O$_{12}$
summary: The recent realization of bulk superconductivity in the quintuple-layer nickelate La$_6$Ni$_5$O$_{12}$ opens new opportunities to probe the pairing symmetry of the reduced Ruddlesden--Popper (RP) nickelate family. Using an effective five-layer Hubbard model and variational Monte Carlo calculations, we find that a spin-singlet $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave state is energetically favored, while extended-$s$-wave pairing is strongly suppressed. Based on the optimized superconducting state, we further calculate several experimentally accessible observables. The tunneling density of states exhibits a characteristic V-shaped low-energy spectrum, the superfluid density shows a linear low-temperature depletion, the Knight shift decreases below $T_c$, and the spin-lattice relaxation rate follows $1/T_1T\propto T^2$, together providing consistent signatures of a clean nodal superconductor. Extending the same framework to related reduced RP nickelates, we find a robust $d$-wave tendency in infinite-layer LaNiO$_{2}$, while trilayer La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{8}$ at its nominal filling lies close to the boundary between $d$-wave superconductivity and a non-superconducting state. These results establish bulk La$_6$Ni$_5$O$_{12}$ as a promising platform for determining the pairing symmetry of nickelate superconductors and suggest a common $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave pairing tendency across the reduced RP nickelate family.

AI.tldr: 本文用五层有效 Hubbard 模型和变分蒙特卡洛研究还原型 RP 镍酸盐超导配对对称性，发现 La6Ni5O12 中自旋单态 d_{x^2-y^2} 波配对最有利，并给出一致表明干净节点超导的实验特征；相关镍酸盐也呈稳健 d 波倾向。
AI.motivation: 五层镍酸盐 La6Ni5O12 中体超导的实现，为探测还原型 Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐家族的配对对称性提供了新机会。
AI.method: 构建有效五层 Hubbard 模型，采用变分蒙特卡洛计算比较不同配对态能量，并基于优化超导态计算隧穿态密度、超流密度、Knight shift、自旋-晶格弛豫率等可观测物理量；随后将同一框架推广到无限层 LaNiO2 与三层 La4Ni3O8。
AI.result: La6Ni5O12 中自旋单态 d_{x^2-y^2} 波态在能量上占优，扩展 s 波配对被强烈抑制。优化态给出 V 形低能隧穿谱、低温超流密度线性耗竭、T_c 以下 Knight shift 下降以及 1/T1T ∝ T^2，构成干净节点超导的一致特征。推广计算显示无限层 LaNiO2 有稳健 d 波倾向，而名义填充的三层 La4Ni3O8 接近 d 波超导与非超导态的边界。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立体相 La6Ni5O12 是判定镍酸盐超导配对对称性的有前景平台，并提示还原型 RP 镍酸盐家族具有共同的 d_{x^2-y^2} 波配对倾向。

title: Band-Resolved Superconducting Gaps via the Thermal Hall Effect in CeRu2
summary: Standard bulk probes of multiband superconductors cannot assign pairing gaps to specific electron or hole Fermi surfaces. Here we show that thermal Hall transport ($\kappa_{xy}$), constrained by specific heat and normal-state magnetotransport, resolves this ambiguity in the compensated heavy-fermion superconductor CeRu$_2$. Fixing the gap magnitudes ($\Delta_e/k_B\approx 13$K, $\Delta_h/k_B\approx 8$K) and band mobilities completely determines the electronic degrees of freedom in $\kappa_{xx}$ and $\kappa_{xy}$. A low-field sign reversal in $\kappa_{xy}$ places the larger gap on the heavy Ce $4f$ electron sheets and the smaller on the hole sheets.

AI.tldr: 热霍尔输运结合比热和正常态磁输运，解决了CeRu2中配对能隙在电子/空穴费米面上的归属问题：大能隙位于Ce 4f电子片，小能隙位于空穴片。
AI.motivation: 传统体测量无法将多带超导体的配对能隙分配给特定电子或空穴费米面，导致能隙归属模糊。
AI.method: 测量并建模热霍尔电导κxy，并用比热与正常态磁输运约束；固定能隙大小Δe/kB≈13 K、Δh/kB≈8 K及带迁移率，完全确定κxx和κxy中的电子自由度。
AI.result: 低场κxy出现符号反转，据此将较大能隙分配给重Ce 4f电子片，较小能隙分配给空穴片。
AI.conclusion: 热霍尔输运可作为区分多带超导体中电子/空穴费米面配对能隙的有效探针，并在补偿重费米子超导体CeRu2中成功应用。

title: Strain-enhanced superconductivity in RuO$_2$ thin films: Joint experimental and theoretical studies
summary: We investigate the superconducting properties of RuO$_2$ films grown on TiO$_2$ substrates by combining film fabrication and transport measurement with \textit{ab initio} calculation. Experimentally, we grow several RuO$_2$ (110) thin films on TiO$_2$ (110) substrates and observe superconductivity with critical temperature ($T_c$) of $\sim$2.0 K in 20-nm and 30-nm RuO$_2$ (110) thin films. Theoretically, we study the superconductivity in both RuO$_2$ (110) and RuO$_2$ (100) epitaxial films within McMillan formalism of isotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory. Among the salient results, the calculated phonon dispersion relations of all the considered RuO$_2$ films show that the epitaxial films are dynamically stable. Importantly, our \textit{ab initio} calculations reveal that independent of the film orientation, the [001] compressive strain $\epsilon_{[001]}$ pushes the flat Ru $d_{z^2}$-dominant bands towards the Fermi level ($E_F$), and significantly soften the out-of-plane acoustic phonon mode near the R point in the Brillouin zone, which substantially enhances the electron-phonon coupling (EPC) strength $\lambda$ and hence the calculated $T_c$ in the RuO$_2$ films. Remarkably, the amount of the phonon softening and the enhanced $T_c$ increase almost linearly with the increasing $\epsilon_{[001]}$. The calculated $T_c$ for the films with thickness of $\geq$ 20 nm agree well with the experimental $T_c$. These findings demonstrate that among other things, lattice mismatch strain provides an effective route for tuning phonon-mediated superconductivity in RuO$_2$ and other thin films.

AI.tldr: 通过薄膜制备、输运测量与第一性原理计算，研究TiO2衬底上RuO2薄膜的超导性，发现20/30 nm RuO2(110)薄膜具有约2.0 K的超导转变温度，并揭示[001]压缩应变通过软化声子增强电子-声子耦合和Tc。
AI.motivation: 探究RuO2薄膜的超导性质，并理解晶格失配应变如何调控声子媒介的超导性。
AI.method: 实验上在TiO2(110)衬底上生长不同厚度RuO2(110)薄膜并进行输运测量；理论上用各向同性Migdal-Eliashberg理论的McMillan形式研究RuO2(110)和(100)外延薄膜的超导性，计算声子色散、电子-声子耦合及Tc。
AI.result: 20 nm和30 nm RuO2(110)薄膜表现出约2.0 K的超导性；计算表明外延薄膜动力学稳定，[001]压缩应变使近平的Ru dz2主导能带靠近费米能级，并显著软化布里渊区R点附近的面向外声学声子模式，从而大幅增强电子-声子耦合强度λ和计算Tc；声子软化程度和Tc随[001]压缩应变近乎线性增加；厚度≥20 nm薄膜的计算Tc与实验Tc吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 晶格失配应变是调控RuO2及其他薄膜中声子媒介超导性的有效途径。

title: Pairing-channel reconstruction by Ising spin-orbit coupling in a multiorbital triangular-lattice model
summary: Ising spin-orbit coupling (SOC) is widely known for locking electronic spins and protecting superconductivity against in-plane paramagnetic pair breaking. Here we show that, in a correlated multiorbital system, Ising SOC can play a qualitatively different role: it reconstructs the hierarchy of spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing channels by reshaping the low-energy Fermi surfaces, orbital-spin coherence factors, and momentum-resolved scattering phase space. We study a noncentrosymmetric two-orbital triangular-lattice model with Rashba SOC, Ising SOC, and onsite SOC. We solve the pairing problem within a multiorbital random-phase-approximation framework. In the single-orbital limit, an $E$-representation state with a dominant $S_z=0$ component emerges only at relatively strong Ising SOC. Orbital degrees of freedom facilitate the stabilization of this pairing state at a smaller nominal Ising SOC strength and generate a broad competition between $E$ and $A_1$ pairing channels. The $E$ state can maintain the same $S_z=0$ triplet character, whereas the $A_1$ state becomes a fully gapped sign-changing $\splusminus$ superconductor. The latter also realizes a topologically nontrivial phase in the time-reversal-invariant weak-pairing regime, with a nonzero $\mathbb{Z}_2$ index, Wilson-loop spectral flow, and boundary modes. Its topology is not carried by a single orbital pairing component, but emerges cooperatively from the dominant intra- and inter-orbital pairing components. These results establish a microscopic route by which Ising SOC and orbital hybridization can reconstruct interaction-driven superconductivity, producing both Ising-triplet and topological singlet-dominated phases in correlated non-centrosymmetric systems.

AI.tldr: 在关联多轨道非中心对称体系中，Ising自旋轨道耦合不仅保护超导，还能通过重塑低能费米面、轨道-自旋相干因子和散射相空间来重构自旋涨落介导的配对通道层级。
AI.motivation: 传统上Ising SOC因锁定电子自旋并保护超导免受面内顺磁对破坏而闻名；作者希望探究其在关联多轨道体系中是否具有定性不同的作用，尤其是如何影响相互作用驱动的超导配对与拓扑性质。
AI.method: 研究一个含Rashba SOC、Ising SOC和 onsite SOC的非中心对称双轨道三角晶格模型，并在多轨道随机相近似（RPA）框架内求解配对问题。
AI.result: 在单轨道极限下，主导Sz=0分量的E表示态仅在较强Ising SOC时出现；轨道自由度可在较小名义Ising SOC下稳定该态，并导致E与A1通道的广泛竞争。E态保持Sz=0三重态特征，而A1态成为全能隙变号s±超导体，并在时间反演不变弱配对区实现拓扑非平庸相，具有非零Z2指数、Wilson环谱流和边界模。其拓扑并非由单一轨道配对分量携带，而是由主要带内和带间配对分量协同涌现。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了Ising SOC与轨道杂化重构相互作用驱动超导的微观路径，可在关联非中心对称体系中产生Ising三重态和拓扑单重态主导相。

title: Vibrational Dressing of Collective Molecular Polaritons: A Scalable Green's-Function Theory
summary: We develop a scalable Green's-function theory of vibrationally dressed molecular-polariton absorption in the Holstein--Tavis--Cummings model. Within the self-consistent Born approximation (SCBA), the ground-state linear response of $N$ identical molecules coupled to one cavity mode follows from a $2\times2$ cavity--bright matrix, while scattering through the $N-1$ dark states remains in the molecular self-energy. The number of self-consistent equations is independent of $N$, allowing large ensembles to be treated without explicitly resolving the dark manifold. Benchmarks against hierarchical equations of motion show that the theory captures collective linewidth narrowing and an $N$-dependent minimum in the lower-polariton linewidth as its exciton fraction varies, beyond a Hopfield-weighted linewidth estimate. Comparisons with exact diagonalization for discrete local vibrations show weaker vibronic progressions and better overall SCBA agreement as $N$ increases at fixed single-molecule coupling. The resulting framework connects microscopic vibrational scattering to collective absorption spectra without introducing fitted polariton linewidths.

AI.tldr: 提出 Holstein–Tavis–Cummings 模型中振动修饰分子极化激元吸收的可扩展格林函数理论，基于自洽 Born 近似，无需显式处理暗态即可计算大 N 系综。
AI.motivation: 需要将微观振动散射与集体极化激元吸收谱联系起来，并避免引入拟合的极化激元线宽，同时克服大分子系综中暗态过多、难以直接求解的问题。
AI.method: 在 SCBA 下，N 个相同分子与单个腔模耦合的基态线性响应由 2×2 腔–亮态矩阵描述；通过 N−1 个暗态的散射纳入分子自能。自洽方程数目与 N 无关，因此可处理大系综而不显式解析暗态流形。
AI.result: 与 HEOM 基准比较，该理论再现了集体线宽窄化以及下极化激元线宽随激子组分变化的 N 依赖极小值，优于 Hopfield 加权线宽估计；与离散局域振动的精确对角化比较，随 N 增大（固定单分子耦合）振动进展变弱且 SCBA 总体符合更好。
AI.conclusion: 该框架从微观振动散射出发连接集体吸收谱，无需拟合极化激元线宽，为大规模分子极化激元吸收提供可扩展理论。

title: Data-Driven Optimization of Seminumerical Exchange for SIMD CPUs
summary: We present a seminumerical exchange algorithm (SNK) based on the sn-LinK method [Laqua et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 16, 1456 (2020)], optimized for modern multi-core central processing units with single instruction multiple data vector instructions and report its implementation into the Q-Chem quantum chemistry program. Vectorization and memory management strategies for the Boys function and 3-center-1-electron (3c1e) integral kernels are given. Several new considerations are made in the computation of the 3c1e integrals: the Head-Gordon Pople horizontal recurrence relations, same-center optimizations, and multishell optimizations, all implemented symbolically employing the SymPy symbolic algebra library and exported as optimized C++ code leveraging common-sub-expression elimination (CSE) optimization techniques. A general scheme for choosing optimal integral kernels is developed through rigorous timing benchmarks. The resulting implementation is tested against traditional 4c2e exchange for several systems and basis sets, showing 1-2 orders of magnitude speedups for systems of practically relevant sizes (100-500 atoms, 2000-10000 basis functions). For smaller molecules, comparisons are also made against the more efficient occ-RI-K method showing a break-even point around 50-100 atoms beyond which SNK dramatically outperforms due to its superior sub-quadratic (between linear and quadratic) time complexity as well as its effectively negligible memory demand.

AI.tldr: 提出基于sn-LinK的半数值交换算法SNK，面向现代多核CPU与SIMD指令优化并实现于Q-Chem；通过对Boys函数和3c1e积分核的向量化、内存管理及符号生成优化，在实用大体系中较传统4c2e交换获得1-2个数量级加速。
AI.motivation: 传统4c2e交换计算成本高、内存需求大；occ-RI-K虽在小分子中高效，但随体系增大性能下降。需要一种兼具亚二次时间复杂度和极低内存需求的交换算法，以处理100-500原子、2000-10000基函数的实际体系。
AI.method: 基于sn-LinK方法构建半数值交换算法SNK，针对多核CPU的SIMD向量化与内存管理优化Boys函数和3c1e积分核；引入Head-Gordon Pople水平递推关系、同中心优化和多壳层优化，使用SymPy符号代数推导并以CSE优化技术导出C++代码；通过严格计时基准建立最优积分核选择方案，并集成到Q-Chem。
AI.result: 对100-500原子、2000-10000基函数体系，相较传统4c2e交换加速1-2个数量级；对较小分子与occ-RI-K比较，约在50-100原子处达到收支平衡，超过该规模后SNK因亚二次时间复杂度和可忽略的内存占用而显著更优。
AI.conclusion: SNK是一种适用于现代CPU、高效且低内存的交换计算方案；在大规模体系中显著优于传统4c2e交换和occ-RI-K，适合实际相关尺寸的量子化学计算。

title: Constrained Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory for Excited-State Dynamics with Nuclear Quantum Effects
summary: Nuclear quantum effects can strongly influence excited-state processes involving light nuclei, yet their inclusion in practical molecular dynamics remains challenging. We develop constrained nuclear-electronic orbital time-dependent density functional theory (CNEO-TDDFT), which incorporates quantum-nuclear delocalization into full-dimensional effective excited-state potential energy surfaces while retaining the formal structure and computational scaling of conventional TDDFT. Analytic gradients are also developed, enabling efficient on-the-fly excited-state dynamics. CNEO-TDDFT substantially improves excited-state vibrational frequencies involving hydrogen motion and reduces the root-mean-square deviation from experiment from 113 cm$^{-1}$ to 26 cm$^{-1}$. For excited-state proton transfer in 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline (HBQ), CNEO-TDDFT yields a characteristic transfer time of 14.0 fs, compared with 25.5 fs from conventional TDDFT, consistent with the experimentally inferred ultrafast timescale of 12$\pm$6 fs. These results establish CNEO-TDDFT as an accurate and efficient framework for excited-state dynamics with nuclear quantum effects.

AI.tldr: 作者发展了约束核电子轨道含时密度泛函理论（CNEO-TDDFT），在保持传统TDDFT形式结构和计算标度的同时，将核量子离域引入全维有效激发态势能面，并开发了解析梯度以支持高效在线激发态动力学。
AI.motivation: 核量子效应会强烈影响涉及轻核的激发态过程，但将其纳入实用的分子动力学仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出CNEO-TDDFT，把量子核离域纳入全维有效激发态势能面，同时保留传统TDDFT的形式结构和计算标度；进一步开发解析梯度，实现高效的on-the-fly激发态动力学。
AI.result: CNEO-TDDFT显著改善涉及氢运动的激发态振动频率，将相对实验的均方根偏差从113 cm^-1降至26 cm^-1；对10-羟基苯并[h]喹啉（HBQ）的激发态质子转移，给出特征转移时间14.0 fs，而传统TDDFT为25.5 fs，与实验推断的超快时间尺度12±6 fs一致。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了CNEO-TDDFT作为包含核量子效应的激发态动力学准确且高效框架的地位。

title: Energy Flow Shapes the Decomposition Dynamics of a Reactive Atmospheric Intermediate
summary: The unimolecular dynamics of Criegee intermediates depend strongly on their internal energy, which can differ substantially between nascent atmospheric species and laboratory-prepared reactants. Here, the decomposition dynamics of {\it anti-}CH$_3$CHOO are investigated using molecular dynamics simulations on a neural network-based potential energy surface under thermal and mode-selective vibrational excitation. Simulations were performed at internal energies representative of those released during ozonolysis (chemical/thermal preparation, TP) or following vibrational excitation (VibEx) along the CH-stretching mode with two or three quanta, as can be done in laboratory studies. These excitation conditions strongly affect reaction yields and kinetics, with VibEx promoting passage across the initial cyclization barrier. For TP, 35 kcal/mol of internal energy are required to form molecular products, whereas for VibEx, 27 kcal/mol are sufficient. Although TP and VibEx ensembles access largely the same fragmentation pathways with comparable relative yields, the absolute product yields, characteristic timescales, and kinetic behavior differ substantially. Methyldioxirane is found to be a kinetic trap along the pathway. The resulting molecular-level description of {\it anti-}CH$_3$CHOO decomposition provides guidance for interpreting experiments and contributes to a broader understanding of energy-dependent Criegee-intermediate dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文用神经网络势能面上的分子动力学模拟研究了anti-CH3CHOO的分解动力学，发现热/化学制备与CH伸缩振动激发会显著改变其反应阈能、产物产量、时间尺度和动力学行为。
AI.motivation: Criegee中间体的单分子动力学强烈依赖内能，而大气新生物种与实验室制备反应物的内能分布可能差异很大，因此需要从分子层面理解不同能量制备方式如何影响其分解。
AI.method: 在神经网络构建的势能面上对anti-CH3CHOO进行分子动力学模拟；分别模拟代表臭氧分解过程的化学/热制备（TP）和沿CH伸缩模加入2或3个振动量子的模式选择性振动激发（VibEx），并比较其分解动力学。
AI.result: VibEx促进跨越初始环化能垒：TP需35 kcal/mol内能才能生成分子产物，而VibEx仅需27 kcal/mol。TP与VibEx基本进入相同的碎裂通道且相对产量相近，但绝对产物产量、特征时间尺度和动力学行为差异显著；甲基二氧杂环丙烷被识别为路径上的动力学陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了anti-CH3CHOO分解的分子级图像，有助于解释相关实验，并推动对能量依赖的Criegee中间体动力学的更广泛理解。

title: From Algebraic Completeness to Orbit Separation: Recursive Separating Invariants for Global Neural Network Potential Energy Surfaces
summary: Permutationally invariant polynomials (PIPs) provide a systematically improvable, symmetry-preserving representation for global potential energy surfaces (PESs), but their high computational cost as neural network descriptors limits applications to large molecular systems. Fundamental invariants (FIs), which form an algebraically complete generating set, substantially reduce the number of descriptors and enable neural network PESs for larger systems. However, PES evaluation remains computationally expensive as molecular size and complexity increase. Here, we introduce recursive separating invariants (RSIs), shifting the descriptor design principle from algebraic completeness to orbit separation. RSIs are constructed systematically through correlation order and recursion depth, providing a more computationally efficient representation. Benchmarks on reactive and nonreactive systems demonstrate that RSI-based neural network (RSI-NN) PESs achieve approximately an order-of-magnitude faster evaluation than their FI-NN counterparts, with system-dependent prediction accuracy that is comparable in several cases. These results establish orbit separation as a promising principle for developing efficient symmetry-preserving descriptors for global neural network PESs.

AI.tldr: 提出递归分离不变量（RSI），以轨道分离替代代数完备性作为描述符设计原则，在保持对称性的同时显著提升神经网络势能面（PES）的评估效率。
AI.motivation: 置换不变多项式（PIP）虽能系统改进并保持对称性，但作为神经网络描述符计算成本高，限制大分子体系应用；基本不变量（FI）虽减少描述符数量，但随分子尺寸和复杂度增加，PES 评估仍很昂贵。
AI.method: 将描述符设计从代数完备生成集转向轨道分离，系统通过关联阶（correlation order）和递归深度（recursion depth）构造递归分离不变量（RSI），并用于构建 RSI-NN 势能面。
AI.result: 在反应与非反应体系基准上，RSI-NN PES 的评估速度比 FI-NN 对应方法约快一个数量级；预测精度依体系而异，在若干情形下与 FI-NN 相当。
AI.conclusion: 轨道分离是开发高效、对称保持描述符以构建全局神经网络势能面的有前景原则。

title: Correlation between normal character and Raman intensities of isotopologues of carbon dioxide
summary: Previous studies on the vibrational structure of carbon dioxide isotopologues have revealed a correlation between the strength of Fermi interactions and a recently defined normal-mode parameter. In this contribution, we investigate how the Raman intensities of the most intense bands evolve across the complete series of carbon dioxide isotopologues at room temperature. To this end, we introduce a general scheme for simulating Raman intensities in linear triatomic molecules, based on the computation of the mean polarizability surface up to cubic terms for all twelve stable species. For the first time, we establish correlations between the degree of normality and the Raman transition intensities, mean polarizability derivatives, and variational Raman shift errors across the CO$_2$ isotopologue series. The observed trends are further analyzed by considering rotational contributions, which may partially account for the deviations observed in the correlations. Our study is supported by experimental Raman spectra of isotopically enriched samples and theoretical simulations. Although this study focuses on carbon dioxide, similar behavior is expected for other series of isotopologues.

AI.tldr: 本文通过计算全部12种稳定CO2同位素体的平均极化率面（至三次项），模拟室温拉曼强度，并首次关联其简正度与拉曼跃迁强度、平均极化率导数及变分拉曼位移误差。
AI.motivation: 已有研究揭示CO2同位素体振动结构中Fermi相互作用强度与简正模式参数相关，但拉曼强度在完整同位素体系中的演化尚不清楚；本文旨在研究最强拉曼谱带强度随CO2同位素体序列的变化并建立相关关系。
AI.method: 提出线性三原子分子拉曼强度模拟通用方案；对全部12种稳定CO2同位素体计算至三次项的平均极化率面；结合同位素富集样品的实验拉曼光谱和理论模拟进行分析。
AI.result: 首次在CO2同位素体系中发现简正度与拉曼跃迁强度、平均极化率导数以及变分拉曼位移误差之间的相关性；引入转动贡献分析，部分解释了相关性中的偏差；实验与理论结果相互支持。
AI.conclusion: CO2同位素体的拉曼强度及相关量随简正度呈现系统趋势；该行为预期也适用于其他同位素体系。

title: Hierarchical universal open structure dataset for atomistic modeling
summary: Atomic-scale simulations have been transformed by machine-learning models that predict the properties of atomistic structures with the accuracy of quantum calculations, but at a small fraction of the cost. These models have increased dramatically in generality, thanks to the availability of synthetic datasets of ever-increasing size and scope. The proliferation of datasets, with properties often computed using different levels of electronic-structure approximation, is problematic, as there is often overlap between different datasets, and strong correlations between structures obtained with short molecular dynamics trajectories or geometry optimization. To address these problems, we introduce a protocol to stratify a dataset into a hierarchy of nested subsets, subsampling from the coarsest to the finest resolution based on an "ecumetric" built to reflect the latent space representation of several popular universal machine-learning interatomic potentials. We then use this approach to combine most of the open structural datasets currently available, consolidating them into MAD-COSMO, a well-organized collection of almost 1.7 billion structures, whose $2^{24}$ most diverse members form the MAD-CORE stratified coreset, which can be easily used for all sorts of tasks, from exploratory experiments to the training of foundation models at scale. We envision that this collection will guide and help coordinate future efforts, focusing them on the most relevant and/or undersampled regions of chemical and structural space, and that it will be further extended to incorporate the outcomes of the collective work of this community.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出基于“ecumetric”的分层数据集构建协议，将现有开放原子结构数据整合为约17亿结构的MAD-COSMO，并抽取2^24个最多样结构组成MAD-CORE核心集。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势虽具量子精度和低成本，但数据集激增、来源与近似级别不一、彼此重叠且结构强相关，导致数据冗余和覆盖偏差，妨碍通用模型训练与评估。
AI.method: 以多个主流通用机器学习原子间势的潜在空间表示构造“ecumetric”度量，将数据集分层为嵌套子集，并从粗到细逐级子采样；随后用该协议合并当前多数开放结构数据集。
AI.result: 构建了MAD-COSMO，包含近17亿个结构；其2^24个最多样成员构成MAD-CORE分层核心集，可用于探索性实验及大规模基础模型训练等任务。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集合有助于指导和协调未来数据生成与模型训练，聚焦化学与结构空间中更相关或欠采样区域，并可由社区集体工作持续扩展。

title: Vertical ionization energies from inverse generalized Kohn-Sham calculations at fixed electron density
summary: The exact Kohn--Sham (KS) system must have its highest occupied orbital energy equal to the negative of the lowest vertical ionization energy (VIE). No comparable theorem connects the deeper occupied levels $\varepsilon_k$ to the higher VIEs $I_k$. Chong, Gritsenko and Baerends (CGB) established empirically that $I_k + \varepsilon_k\propto\sqrt{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{HOMO}}-\varepsilon_k}$. We ask whether a similar relation holds for the exact generalized Kohn-Sham (GKS) system, which incorporates a fraction $\alpha$ of Hartree-Fock exchange. We invert near-exact CCSD/aug-cc-pVQZ ground-state densities of LiH, LiF, H$_2$O, HF, CO, N$_2$ and F$_2$ at $\alpha = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0$ and obtain the exact GKS systems at each admixture. As the density is held fixed and only the operator is varied, the resulting occupied spectra separate the effect of exact-exchange admixture on orbital energies from its effect on the density, two contributions inseparable in a self-consistent hybrid calculation. The CGB relation holds broadly across the family, with a proportionality coefficient linear in $\alpha$, $c(\alpha)=c(0)-s\alpha$, where $c(0)=1.185\pm0.017$ eV$^{1/2}$ and $s=1.987\pm0.041$ eV$^{1/2}$, with $R^{2}\ge0.9996$ for H$_2$O, CO, HF and N$_2$. Using the response-potential matrix elements tabulated by Gritsenko, Bra\"ida and Baerends, we decompose the CGB coefficient into response and spectroscopic parts, and find $s$ to agree with the homogeneous-electron-gas step-height coefficient $K_g = 1.9932$ eV$^{1/2}$, which we conjecture is its origin. The coefficient vanishes at $\alpha^{*}=0.597\pm0.008$. At $\alpha^{*}$ the HOMO-referenced GKS occupied levels satisfy $\varepsilon_k\approx-I_k$ across the whole occupied range. The zero crossing is fixed by the core orbitals; in the outer valence the CGB coefficient is already indistinguishable from zero at $\alpha=0$.

AI.tldr: 该文检验精确广义 Kohn-Sham（GKS）体系中深占据轨道能 ε_k 与较高垂直电离能 I_k 是否满足类似 CGB 的经验关系，发现 I_k+ε_k 与 √(ε_HOMO−ε_k) 成正比，且比例系数随 Hartree-Fock 交换分数 α 线性变化。
AI.motivation: 精确 Kohn-Sham 理论只保证最高占据轨道能与最低垂直电离能相关，没有定理将更深占据轨道能 ε_k 与更高电离能 I_k 联系起来；作者希望确认 CGB 经验关系在含 α 分数 Hartree-Fock 交换的精确 GKS 体系中是否仍成立，并分离交换混合对轨道能与对密度的影响。
AI.method: 对 LiH、LiF、H2O、HF、CO、N2、F2，使用近精确 CCSD/aug-cc-pVQZ 基态密度进行反演，在 α=0、0.25、0.5、0.75、1.0 下获得精确 GKS 体系；固定密度、仅改变算符，从而把精确交换混合对轨道能的影响与对密度的影响分开；随后拟合 CGB 关系并分解其比例系数。
AI.result: CGB 关系在该分子家族中广泛成立，比例系数为 c(α)=c(0)−sα，其中 c(0)=1.185±0.017 eV^{1/2}，s=1.987±0.041 eV^{1/2}；对 H2O、CO、HF、N2，R²≥0.9996。分解后 s 与均匀电子气台阶高度系数 K_g=1.9932 eV^{1/2} 一致，作者猜想后者是其来源。系数在 α*=0.597±0.008 处消失；此时以 HOMO 为参考的 GKS 占据轨道满足 ε_k≈−I_k 覆盖整个占据范围。零交叉由核心轨道决定；在外价区域，α=0 时 CGB 系数已与零不可区分。
AI.conclusion: 精确 GKS 体系将 CGB 关系推广为随交换混合分数 α 线性变化的规律；在特定 α* 下，深占据 GKS 轨道能可近似等于对应垂直电离能的负值；该线性斜率可能与均匀电子气台阶高度系数相关，而零交叉主要由核心轨道控制。

authors: Floris F. S. van der Tak
title: Rovibrational cross sections for the CO$_2$ $00^00$, $01^10$, $02^20$ and Fermi resonance states $10^00(1)$ and $10^00(2)$ in collisions with He atoms
summary: We present quantum scattering calculations of CO$_2$-He state-to-state integral cross sections for 25 transition sets, covering pure rotational transitions within and rovibrational transitions between: the ground state $00^00$, the bend fundamental $01^10$, the bending overtone $02^20$, and the Fermi doublet states $10^00(1)$ and $10^00(2)$. Exact coupled-channel (CC) and coupled-states approximation (CSA) calculations are performed using a new five-dimensional potential energy surface. The calculations cover collision energies from 20 to 5220 cm$^{-1}$, sufficient to obtain converged rate coefficients over 100-800 K, and include initial rotational states for each transition up to at least $j=35$. We present an energy-grid algorithm for rovibrational quantum scattering calculations that minimizes the number of separate calculations required. The resulting cross sections exhibit a dominant $\Delta j=0$ propensity and parity-dependent patterns. For the benchmark $00^00,j' \leftarrow 01^10,j$ transition, thermally averaged rate coefficients reproduce available experimental data. A comparison between the CC and CSA cross sections shows that, for vibrational quenching transitions, the CSA cross sections increasingly deviate from the CC results with increasing initial rotational state $j$. Calculated integral cross sections cover collision energies and rotational states needed to derive rate coefficients for non local thermal equilibrium radiative transfer modeling of mid-infrared CO$_2$ spectra. The computationally simpler CO$_2$-He system allows the methodology and approximations to be tested at high collision energies and rotational states, helping assess their suitability for the more complex and astrochemically important CO$_2$-H$_2$ system.

AI.tldr: 该工作对CO2-He体系进行态-态量子散射计算，使用新五维势能面，覆盖25组纯转动和振转跃迁、20–5220 cm−1碰撞能量、100–800 K速率系数及至少j=35初态；截面显示Δj=0主导和宇称依赖，热平均速率与实验吻合，CSA在高j振动淬灭时偏离CC。
AI.motivation: 为中红外CO2非局域热平衡辐射转移建模获取所需速率系数，并借助较简单的CO2-He体系在高碰撞能和转动态下检验方法及近似，以评估其用于更复杂且天体化学重要的CO2-H2体系的适用性。
AI.method: 采用新五维势能面，对CO2-He进行精确耦合通道(CC)和耦合态近似(CSA)量子散射计算，得到涵盖基态00^0 0、弯曲基频01^1 0、弯曲泛频02^2 0及Fermi双态10^0 0(1)和10^0 0(2)之间/内部25组跃迁的态-态积分截面；碰撞能20–5220 cm−1，初态转动量子数至少到j=35；并提出减少独立计算数的能量网格算法。
AI.result: 截面呈现主导的Δj=0倾向和宇称依赖模式；基准跃迁00^0 0,j′←01^1 0,j的热平均速率系数再现现有实验数据；对振动淬灭跃迁，CSA截面随初始j增大而越来越偏离CC结果。
AI.conclusion: 所得积分截面覆盖非局域热平衡辐射转移建模中红外CO2光谱所需的碰撞能和转动态范围，可用于推导速率系数；同时CO2-He可作为测试平台，在高碰撞能和转动态下评估方法近似，并帮助判断其能否推广至更复杂且天体化学重要的CO2-H2体系。

title: Simulated Solvation Dynamics of a Photoexcited Organic Molecule and the Associated Time-Resolved X-ray Scattering Signal
summary: Solvation shell reorganization is a key component of the dynamics after photoexcitation of a solvated molecule, especially for charge-transfer excitation in polar solvents. These structural dynamics can be directly observed with time-resolved X-ray solution scattering (TR-XSS) experiments. However, disentangling the scattering signal of solvation-shell reorganization can be challenging, especially for systems containing only light atoms. Here, nonequilibrium molecular dynamics simulations of a hemithioindigo chromophore in acetonitrile are used to investigate the solvation dynamics upon photoinduced charge transfer as well as vibrational excitation and cooling, and to characterize the corresponding time-resolved X-ray scattering signals. It is found that charge transfer induces rapid reorientation of the first solvation shell (0.15-0.2 ps) followed by slower reorientational and solvent redistribution within and between shells (1-2 ps). An analysis of the volume around the solute excluded to the solvent reveals an initial contraction of the solvation shell, followed by transient rebound within the first 0.4 ps, and then slower contraction. Instantaneous vibrational excitation expands the excluded volume, reaching a maximum near 0.4 ps, followed by contraction during cooling with biexponential relaxation. Low-q features in both the calculated solute-solvent and solvent-solvent scattering signals reflect rearrangements within the first solvation shell and redistribution across shells, while higher-q solute-solvent features more closely follow local first-shell restructuring. These results show that TR-XSS can provide information on both local solvent rearrangements and redistribution across solvation shells and demonstrate that interpreting the scattering signals requires accounting for changes in solvent packing induced by vibrational heating and cooling of the solute.

AI.tldr: 该文通过非平衡分子动力学模拟研究半硫靛染料在乙腈中的光诱导电荷转移及振动激发/冷却过程，并计算时间分辨X射线溶液散射（TR-XSS）信号，揭示溶剂壳重组、排除体积变化及其散射特征。
AI.motivation: 溶剂壳重组是溶剂化分子光激发后动力学的关键组成部分，尤其对极性溶剂中的电荷转移激发而言；TR-XSS可直接观测这些结构动力学，但轻原子体系中溶剂壳重组散射信号难以解耦，因此需要建立微观动力学与散射信号之间的联系。
AI.method: 对乙腈中的半硫靛发色团进行非平衡分子动力学模拟，模拟光诱导电荷转移、振动激发和冷却过程，分析溶剂化动力学并表征相应的TR-XSS信号；同时分析溶质周围溶剂排除体积随时间的变化。
AI.result: 电荷转移诱导第一溶剂壳快速重取向（0.15–0.2 ps），随后在1–2 ps内发生较慢的壳内重取向和壳间溶剂再分布。排除体积先收缩，0.4 ps内出现瞬态回弹，随后缓慢收缩。瞬态振动激发使排除体积膨胀，约0.4 ps达最大，冷却时以双指数弛豫收缩。低q的溶质-溶剂和溶剂-溶剂散射信号反映第一溶剂壳内重组及壳间再分布，较高q的溶质-溶剂特征更接近局域第一壳重构。
AI.conclusion: TR-XSS可同时提供局域溶剂重组和跨溶剂壳再分布信息；解释散射信号时必须考虑溶质振动加热与冷却引起的溶剂堆积变化。

title: Learning the information contained in the microstructure of data distributions
summary: Understanding how much and where information is nested in sets of data obtained using different parameters and metrics is a typical problem in the analysis of high-dimensional datasets. Approaches based on relative data-driven metrics may be poorly quantitative and difficult to interpret, while accurate methods may be computationally expensive and impractical for large datasets. Here, we report an efficient, quantitative, and transferable method useful to this end, which we call "Micro-Information Analysis". Its foundation is based on the tight relationship that exists between the microscopic features of data distributions and the information they contain. The method performs preliminary unsupervised clustering, capturing microstructural features of data distributions such as the dominant Gaussian microdomains (microstates) present in them, their population, separation, and their residual non-Gaussian fraction. Leveraging the principle of clustering-and-minimization of Shannon entropy, this allows quantifying in bit (that is, in absolute metric) the information contained in the microstructure of the data, and how much information is nested in each Gaussian and non-Gaussian microdomain. The output of the analysis is a set of easily interpretable Information-Microstructure plots that allow to readily compare and rank data based on their information content and to graphically map the information breakdown among their various microenvironments in diagrams that are easy to interpret. We prove the efficiency of our method by analyzing and ranking data generated synthetically or from molecular simulations, demonstrating how "Micro-Information Analysis" is a physically-grounded quantitative tool useful for the study of physical systems from their data and for data science in general.

AI.tldr: 提出 Micro-Information Analysis：先无监督聚类，基于高斯微域及其熵最小化，用比特量化数据微结构中嵌套的信息，并生成可解释的信息-微结构图，用于比较和排序数据集。
AI.motivation: 高维数据分析中常需理解不同参数或度量下数据中信息嵌套的位置与数量；相对数据驱动指标难以定量解释，精确方法计算昂贵、难以用于大数据。
AI.method: 对数据做预无监督聚类，捕获主导高斯微域（微状态）、其总体、分离度及残余非高斯部分；利用聚类与 Shannon 熵最小化原则，以绝对单位 bit 量化微结构总信息及各高斯/非高斯微域中的信息，并输出 Information-Microstructure 图。
AI.result: 在合成数据和分子模拟数据上进行分析与排序，证明方法高效；输出可直观比较和排序数据的信息含量，并图解各微环境中的信息分解。
AI.conclusion: Micro-Information Analysis 是一种高效、定量、可迁移且有物理基础的工具，适用于从数据研究物理系统以及通用数据科学。

title: Adding Temperature to the Adiabatic Connection: Hybrid Functionals for Static and Dynamic Correlation
summary: Capturing static and dynamic electron correlation simultaneously at manageable computational cost remains a key challenge in electronic structure theory. Motivated by the recurring role of effective temperature in self-consistent field methods we extend the adiabatic connection mechanism from density functional theory to include a temperature dimension. This gives rise to thermally enhanced hybrid functionals, in which static correlation is captured via fractional occupations generated by an effective "correlation temperature" within thermal Hartree-Fock, while dynamic correlation is described by established density functional approximations. The framework formally unifies information-density matrix functional theory (i-DMFT) and thermally-assisted-occupation (TAO-)DFT as special cases, clarifying their theoretical basis and the respective prescriptions for the temperature parameter. We assess the performance of several thermally enhanced hybrids for different cases where i-DMFT was previously shown to fail. Furthermore, we discuss and test different schemes for determining the correlation temperature and investigate the accuracy of different such choices for a benchmark set derived from biphenyl. The results help to clarify the achievable balance of accuracy, generality, and efficiency, establishing thermally enhanced hybrids as a systematic route toward low-cost treatment of both correlation types.

AI.tldr: 提出热增强混合泛函，将密度泛函理论中的绝热连接扩展到温度维度，以低成本同时处理静态和动态电子关联。
AI.motivation: 在可接受计算成本下同时捕获静态与动态电子关联仍是电子结构理论的关键挑战；受自洽场方法中有效温度作用的启发。
AI.method: 将绝热连接机制从密度泛函理论扩展到包含温度维度，构建热增强混合泛函：在热Hartree-Fock中通过有效“关联温度”产生分数占据以描述静态关联，动态关联由成熟密度泛函近似描述；该框架形式上将i-DMFT与TAO-DFT统一为特例，并讨论温度参数的确定方案。
AI.result: 评估了多种热增强混合泛函在i-DMFT先前失败案例中的表现，并测试了不同关联温度确定方案在联苯衍生基准集上的精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果有助于明确精度、通用性与效率之间的平衡，确立热增强混合泛函作为低成本同时处理两类电子关联的系统性途径。

title: AeroProp-X: An Open-Source, Self-Verifying Method-of-Characteristics Toolkit for Edge-Capable Rocket Nozzle Design and Aerothermodynamic Analysis
summary: The design of supersonic rocket nozzles by the Method of Characteristics is a mature discipline, yet the software that implements it is frequently either proprietary, heavyweight, or opaque, which limits reproducibility and classroom and field use. This paper presents AeroProp-X, an open-source, dependency-light toolkit that synthesizes shock-free minimum-length nozzle contours and evaluates their ideal aerothermodynamic performance entirely on commodity hardware without graphics acceleration or network access. The central contribution is methodological rather than physical: the planar characteristics solver is made self-verifying by exploiting an exact gas-dynamic invariant, namely that the computed exit wall height ratio must equal the isentropic area ratio at the design Mach number, so that every generated contour reports its own discretization error automatically. We describe the governing theory, the layered software architecture, and the synthesis algorithm, and we validate the implementation against analytic compressible-flow tables and against the expansion ratios of historical flight engines. The solver reproduces tabulated gas-dynamic quantities to table precision and converges to the exact area ratio with relative error below three parts in ten thousand, while remaining small enough to run interactively on an embedded-class processor. We argue that built-in verifiability, dependency minimalism, and explicit scoping of the ideal-flow assumptions together make the tool well suited to education, preliminary design, and reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 提出开源、轻依赖的 AeroProp-X 工具包，用特征线法合成无激波最短长度超声速喷管型面，并自校验地评估理想气动热力学性能。
AI.motivation: 现有超声速火箭喷管特征线法设计软件多为专有、笨重或不透明，限制可复现性、课堂与现场使用。
AI.method: 采用平面特征线法求解器合成无激波最短长度喷管，核心是方法学贡献：利用精确气体动力学不变量，使计算得到的出口壁高比必须等于设计马赫数下的等熵面积比，从而自动报告离散误差；软件分层架构、依赖极简，无需图形加速或联网，可在普通/嵌入式级处理器上运行。
AI.result: 与可压缩流解析表及历史飞行发动机膨胀比对比验证；复现表列气体动力学量至表格精度，并以低于万分之三的相对误差收敛到精确面积比，且可交互运行于嵌入式级处理器。
AI.conclusion: 内置可验证性、依赖最小化及对理想流假设的明确界定，使该工具适用于教学、初步设计与可复现研究。

title: Physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (PIKANs) for noise-robust reconstruction of boiling heat flux from infrared measurements
summary: Recovering a noise-amplified inverse quantity from corrupted boundary data is a recurring problem in physics-informed learning for real-world applications. Specifically, small perturbations in the measured field are magnified through the spatial derivatives needed to reconstruct the target, and hence conventional discretization solvers turn them into large unphysical oscillations. We study this problem through the reconstruction of local time-resolved nucleate-boiling heat flux, which cannot be measured directly and must be inferred from infrared surface temperatures by solving an unsteady three-dimensional heat-conduction problem with sharp and rapidly evolving liquid-vapor interface gradients. We show that neither network architecture nor optimizer alone overcomes the spectral bias that smooths away these interface-scale features, and that the two must be addressed jointly. Our approach combines a Chebyshev physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network (PIKAN) backbone, a quasi-second-order (SOAP) optimizer, and a temperature-annealed residual-based resampling scheme that concentrates collocation points at high-residual interface regions. Trained directly on experimental infrared measurements imposed as a boundary condition, the network resolves high-frequency bubble signatures and the high-flux distribution tail much better than a Fourier-feature PINN of equal size and training budget. In particular, it selectively filters measurement noise while preserving the physically meaningful high-frequency features, suppressing the spurious oscillations that contaminate finite-volume reconstructions and yielding more physically consistent heat-flux estimates from noisy experimental data.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出 Chebyshev PIKAN、SOAP 优化器与温度退火残差重采样相结合的物理信息学习框架，从含噪红外表面温度反演局部时间分辨核沸腾热流，在抑制噪声放大的同时保留界面高频特征。
AI.motivation: 从受污染边界数据恢复噪声放大的逆物理量是常见难题：测量场的小扰动会被重构目标所需的空间导数放大，传统离散求解器会将其转化为大幅非物理振荡。核沸腾热流无法直接测量，需由红外表面温度求解具有尖锐且快速演化液-气界面梯度的非定常三维热传导问题，因此对噪声鲁棒且能解析界面尺度特征的反演方法至关重要。
AI.method: 作者指出单独改进网络架构或优化器均无法克服平滑界面尺度特征的谱偏差，必须联合处理二者。方法结合 Chebyshev 物理信息 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（PIKAN）主干、准二阶 SOAP 优化器，以及温度退火的基于残差重采样策略，将配点集中到高残差的界面区域；并以实验红外测量作为边界条件直接训练。
AI.result: 在与同规模、同训练预算的 Fourier-feature PINN 对比中，该方法更好地解析高频气泡信号和高热流分布尾部；能够选择性滤除测量噪声，同时保留物理有意义的高频特征，抑制有限体积重构中出现的虚假振荡，并从含噪实验数据中得到更物理一致的热流估计。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，解决此类噪声放大逆问题需联合设计网络架构与优化器；所提框架对核沸腾热流反演有效，并可推广至其他由含噪边界数据推断导数敏感物理量的物理信息学习任务。

title: Iterative Neural Variational Solver of Committor Function in Under-damped Langevin Dynamics
summary: The committor function describes the probability that a stochastic dynamical system, while transitioning between two metastable states, will first reach one state rather than the other. It is a central object in transition path theory, providing the accurate reaction rate and the characterization of the transition mechanism through reactive probability flux and the transition state ensemble. While the numerical methods for this function are well studied for over-damped Langevin dynamics where the friction damping coefficient goes to infinity, its computation in the general under-damped case remains an open challenge due to the lack of a variational structure in the underlying backward Kolmogorov equation. This restricts the quantitative investigation of the impact of the finite damping coefficient on rare transitions in real systems. In this work, by decomposing the infinitesimal generator of the underdamped Langevin dynamics into a self-adjoint and a skew-adjoint part, we develop an iterative scheme in which each subproblem has a variational form and can be solved efficiently using neural networks. Fundamentally, this approach can be viewed as a generalized Concus-Golub-Widlund (CGW) splitting method and each subproblem has a variational form, which can be solved efficiently. This iterative scheme also has the flexibility of introducing a preconditioning operator associated with a new overdamped Langevin dynamics, which naturally leads to the design of enhanced adaptive sampling for the subproblems. We validate the efficiency and accuracy of our method on benchmark systems including a one-dimensional double-well potential, the Muller-Brown potential, and alanine dipeptide. The proposed iterative variational framework provides a practical and extensible numerical tool for probing rare transition events in Langevin dynamics across varying damping coefficients.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种求解欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学中 committor 函数的迭代变分框架，通过算子分裂与神经网络求解，并可处理不同阻尼系数下的稀有跃迁问题。
AI.motivation: committor 函数是 transition path theory 的核心，可给出反应速率、反应概率通量和 transition state ensemble；但现有数值方法主要针对过阻尼 Langevin 动力学，欠阻尼情形因 backward Kolmogorov 方程缺乏变分结构而仍具挑战，限制了对有限阻尼影响的定量研究。
AI.method: 将欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学的无穷小生成元分解为自伴部分和反自伴部分，构造迭代格式，使每个子问题具有变分形式并用神经网络高效求解；方法可视为广义 Concus-Golub-Widlund (CGW) splitting，并可引入与新过阻尼 Langevin 动力学相关的前置算子，从而设计增强自适应采样。
AI.result: 在一维双势阱、Muller-Brown 势和丙氨酸二肽等基准体系上验证了该方法的效率与精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的迭代变分框架为研究不同阻尼系数下 Langevin 动力学中的稀有跃迁事件提供了实用且可扩展的数值工具。

title: pcNN-SN: a physics-enhanced predictor-corrector neural network algorithm coupled with the discrete ordinates method for neutron transport equations
summary: Super-resolution machine learning methods hold promise for addressing the high computational costs associated with high-dimensional features in traditional transport simulations. This paper proposes a physics-enhanced neural network coupling algorithm for discrete ordinates (SN) transport calculations. Based on high- and low-accuracy data, we develop a predictor-corrector neural network (pcNN) to predict correction factors for coarse-grid solutions. Based on transport equations, local physical features containing subgrid-scale information are selected as network inputs. Dimensionless transformation of physical quantities reduces the input space dimensionality and narrows parameter distributions, facilitating network training. Physical constraints are incorporated into the network model, and the corrected solution retains its original conservation properties. pcNN and SN transport sweeps are internally coupled, and numerical solutions are corrected online. Numerical results demonstrate that this algorithm can effectively improve coarse-grid solutions to achieve a level of accuracy comparable to that of fine-grid results. The physics-based network design enables the model to demonstrate a certain degree of reusability under different computational conditions. Compared to mesh refinement, the pcNN-SN algorithm reduces the computation time for the three-dimensional test problem by more than 60%.

AI.tldr: 提出物理增强的预测-校正神经网络（pcNN）与离散纵标（SN）输运扫描耦合算法，用粗网格解预测修正因子并在线校正，在保持守恒性的同时达到细网格精度；三维测试中较网格加密减少计算时间60%以上。
AI.motivation: 传统输运模拟中高维特征导致计算成本高；超分辨率机器学习具降本潜力，但需融入物理约束与子网格尺度信息，以提升粗网格解精度、守恒性和跨工况复用能力。
AI.method: 基于高/低精度数据训练pcNN预测粗网格解的修正因子；依据输运方程选取含亚网格尺度信息的局部物理特征作为网络输入；对物理量做无量纲变换以降低输入维数并收窄参数分布；将物理约束嵌入网络模型，使校正解保持原守恒性质；pcNN与SN输运扫描内耦合，在线修正数值解。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，该算法能有效提升粗网格解至接近细网格精度；基于物理的网络设计使模型在不同计算条件下具有一定重用性；相较网格加密，pcNN-SN算法在三维测试问题中减少计算时间超过60%。
AI.conclusion: pcNN-SN是一种有效的物理增强超分辨率耦合方案，可在保持守恒性与精度的同时显著降低SN输运计算成本，并具备一定跨工况复用能力。

title: Representation-split Carleman lattice Boltzmann with near-unit step success probability on quantum computers
summary: The Carleman lattice Boltzmann method replaces the quadratic collision of the lattice Boltzmann equation by a linear map on a lifted state. Existing block encodings of this map succeed with probability $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$ per step, so that the probability of a multi-step evolution decays exponentially with the number of steps. This study develops multi-relaxation-time Carleman lattice Boltzmann, a representation split in which the Carleman-lifted collision is performed in a moment basis on the amplitude-encoded state, while streaming remains a permutation in population space. The level-2 hierarchy closes under collision but not under streaming, which generates the work of pressure, advection and stress on the momentum flux. The state therefore remains the full pair array, and the moment representation is an orthogonal change of basis of the population one, with identical dynamics and truncation error. The operator to be block encoded changes with the basis, and with it the success probability of a quantum step. In the weighted Hermite basis with the amplitude encoding $f_i/\sqrt{w_i}$, the relaxation is a diagonal operator of norm one, and the level-2 collision stage becomes this diagonal plus a sparse coupling from products of conserved moments. A structured block encoding of this form raises the single-step success probability on the D2Q9 lattice from $10^{-2}$ for the best population encoding to 0.98. With the pair sector in relative coordinates and scaled, one step requires $O(\log^2 N)$ Toffoli gates and is verified by statevector simulation. The encoding and readout overhead of a $T$-step run is then polynomial in $T$ and $N$ rather than accumulating a factor $p^T$. For resolved flows, the remaining exponential loss in coherent multi-step Carleman lattice Boltzmann evolution is set by the non-equilibrium norm relaxed by dissipation rather than by the block encoding.

AI.tldr: 提出多松弛时间 Carleman 格子 Boltzmann 的量子编码方案：在加权 Hermite 矩基与振幅编码 f_i/√w_i 下，将碰撞算符块编码为对角加稀疏耦合，D2Q9 单步成功概率由 10^-2 提升至 0.98，且一步仅需 O(log^2 N) 个 Toffoli 门。
AI.motivation: 现有 Carleman 提升线性化碰撞的块编码单步成功概率仅 10^-5 至 10^-2，多步演化成功概率随步数指数衰减，限制了相干多步量子模拟。
AI.method: 采用表示拆分：Carleman 提升后的碰撞在矩基下作用于振幅编码态，而 streaming 在 population 空间仍为置换。截断到 level-2 时，碰撞闭合但 streaming 不闭合，产生压力、对流和应力对动量通量的贡献；态保持完整 pair 数组，矩表示只是 population 表示的正交基变换，动力学与截断误差不变。选取加权 Hermite 基和 f_i/√w_i 振幅编码，使松弛为范数 1 的对角算符，level-2 碰撞为对角加由守恒矩乘积产生的稀疏耦合；对 pair 扇区采用相对坐标并缩放，构造结构化块编码并通过 statevector 仿真验证。
AI.result: 在 D2Q9 格子上，单步成功概率从最佳 population 编码的 10^-2 提升到 0.98；一步演化需 O(log^2 N) 个 Toffoli 门。T 步运行的编码与读出开销为 T 和 N 的多项式，而非累积 p^T 指数因子。
AI.conclusion: 该矩基振幅编码显著改善 Carleman 格子 Boltzmann 的块编码成功概率，去除了由块编码导致的多步指数损失；对已解析流动，剩余指数损失由耗散松弛的非平衡范数决定，而非块编码。

title: On the Assessment of Domain Decomposition Approaches in Extended Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Shock-Dominated Burgers Equation
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations but often struggle with sharp gradients and shock-dominated solutions. Extended Physics-Informed Neural Networks (XPINNs) address this challenge through domain decomposition; however, the effects of decomposition design, overlap, and local network capacity on solution accuracy remain insufficiently characterized. This work presents a systematic assessment of domain decomposition configurations for XPINNs applied to the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation ($\nu=0.01/\pi$). We compare a standard PINN, a conventional XPINN, a shock-focused XPINN with increased network capacity in the shock-containing subdomain, and overlapping XPINNs with different overlap widths. All configurations are trained using a common protocol based on Adam, L-BFGS refinement, and ten Residual-based Adaptive Refinement (RAR) cycles. Performance is evaluated against a reference solution using global and shock-region relative $L_2$ and $L_\infty$ errors, maximum PDE residuals, and interface continuity errors. The results show that decomposition design strongly affects XPINN accuracy and shock resolution. Among the overlapping configurations, the smallest overlap provides the best accuracy, while larger overlaps degrade performance. The shock-focused XPINN achieves the lowest overall solution errors, indicating that increased local network capacity can provide greater benefit than increasing overlap alone. RAR produces the largest improvements during early refinement stages, followed by increasingly non-monotonic changes in accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of jointly considering decomposition, interface coupling, network capacity, and adaptive refinement for shock-dominated problems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了XPINN在一维黏性Burgers方程（ν=0.01/π）上的域分解配置，比较标准PINN、常规XPINN、冲击区增容XPINN及不同重叠宽度的XPINN，发现分解设计、局部网络容量、界面耦合与自适应细化共同决定激波主导问题的求解精度。
AI.motivation: PINN虽可无网格求解偏微分方程，但在尖锐梯度和激波主导解上表现不佳；XPINN通过域分解缓解该问题，但分解设计、重叠宽度和局部网络容量对精度的影响仍缺乏系统表征。
AI.method: 针对一维黏性Burgers方程（ν=0.01/π），比较标准PINN、常规XPINN、在含激波子域增加网络容量的冲击聚焦XPINN，以及不同重叠宽度的重叠XPINN。所有配置采用统一训练协议：Adam、L-BFGS细化及10轮基于残差的自适应细化（RAR）。以参考解评估全局与激波区相对L2/L∞误差、最大PDE残差和界面连续性误差。
AI.result: 分解设计显著影响XPINN精度与激波分辨率。重叠配置中最小重叠精度最佳，较大重叠反而降低性能。冲击聚焦XPINN获得最低整体解误差，表明增加局部网络容量比单纯增大重叠更有效。RAR在早期细化阶段改进最大，随后精度变化趋于非单调。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，对于激波主导问题，需联合考虑域分解、界面耦合、网络容量与自适应细化，以提升XPINN的求解精度和激波捕捉能力。

title: Energy-Stable Parametric Operator Inference across Regime Transitions: Application to Unconfined Buoyant Plumes in Stratified Ambients
summary: Buoyant plumes in stratified ambients arise in wildfire smoke transport, ventilation, and pollutant dispersion, where many-query prediction requires models that stay accurate and stable as the dynamics transition from free rise to internal-wave trapping. Operator Inference (OpInf) learns polynomial reduced models from snapshots, and the Boussinesq plume depends affinely on the squared buoyancy frequency $N^2$. However, this compatibility masks two stability gaps: a single affine operator family can distort the per-parameter dynamics into unstable spectra, and for quadratic OpInf models, finite-time blowup is governed by a cubic energy injection channel from the inferred quadratic operator. To address these gaps, we develop cyclic-skew regime-bridged OpInf (CR-OpInf). We derive an affine-inadequacy diagnostic that links the departure from a shared affine family to destabilizing spectral drift before integration. In place of the shared affine fit, we interpolate per-parameter operators with a Gaussian kernel. We also extend the cyclic-skew quadratic constraint to the buoyancy-source-forced parametric setting, closing the cubic energy channel and isolating this closure as the boundedness mechanism. We further introduce a regime-bridging basis split that resolves free rise and trapped intrusion structures while preserving the cyclic-skew structure under convex interpolation. Applied to an unconfined Boussinesq plume and a viscous Burgers problem spanning a smooth-to-shock transition, CR-OpInf remains bounded for five training horizons, avoids the divergence of affine and unconstrained variants, tracks the plume rise, and recovers stratification-dependent rise scaling at moderate horizons. To our knowledge, this is the first parametric OpInf study of an unconfined stratified plume.

AI.tldr: 提出 CR-OpInf：用高斯核逐参数算子插值、循环斜对称二次约束和 regime-bridging 基分裂，解决分层浮力羽流参数化 OpInf 的谱不稳定与有限时间爆破问题，并在无侧限 Boussinesq 羽流和 Burgers 问题上保持有界且准确。
AI.motivation: 分层环境中的浮力羽流（野火烟羽、通风、污染物扩散）需要多查询预测，且动力学会从自由上升到内波捕获转变，因此降阶模型必须准确且稳定。OpInf 可从快照学习多项式降阶模型，Boussinesq 羽流对 N^2 呈仿射依赖，但单个仿射算子族可能扭曲逐参数动力学并导致不稳定谱；二次 OpInf 还存在由推断二次算子经三次能量注入通道引起的有限时间爆破风险。
AI.method: 开发 cyclic-skew regime-bridged OpInf（CR-OpInf）。首先推导仿射不足诊断，在积分前将偏离共享仿射族与失稳谱漂移关联；其次用高斯核插值逐参数算子，替代共享仿射拟合；再将 cyclic-skew 二次约束扩展到浮力源强迫参数设置，关闭三次能量通道，并将其隔离为有界性机制；最后引入 regime-bridging 基分裂，在凸插值下保持 cyclic-skew 结构，同时分辨自由上升和捕获入侵结构。
AI.result: 在无侧限 Boussinesq 羽流和跨越光滑到激波过渡的黏性 Burgers 问题上，CR-OpInf 在五个训练时域内保持有界，避免仿射和无约束变体发散，能够跟踪羽流上升，并在中等时域恢复分层相关的上升标度。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个无侧限分层羽流的参数化 OpInf 研究；CR-OpInf 为从自由上升到内波捕获的过渡动力学提供了稳定、准确且具参数泛化能力的降阶建模框架。

title: BBun: an unsteady vortex-ring panel method for interacting lifting bodies, box wings and propellers
summary: This report documents BBun (Blunt Body unsteady), a low-order code for the unsteady potential flow around one or more interacting three-dimensional bodies. The bodies are represented by vortex rings (piecewise-constant doublets) with a Neumann boundary condition; free vortex sheets are shed from the trailing edges and, optionally, from the tips, and convected in time, with an implicit unsteady Kutta condition. The report describes the choices that make the discretization consistent and convergent (a single desingularized kernel per wake line, a bordered factorization of the singular Neumann problem, interior velocity conditions for the nearly singular mode of ring-shaped bodies, the detection of the separation lines from the grid connectivity) and the extensions to several bodies, box wings, symmetric configurations (image method), non-lifting bodies, rigidly rotating bodies (propellers), the unsteady Bernoulli equation, a wake-body collision treatment and a strip-wise integral boundary layer. The verification and validation are reported in full: potential flow around a sphere, sensitivity and grid convergence, the two-dimensional limit, an independent vortex-lattice method, the NACA 0015 wing of McAlister and Takahashi (loads and chordwise pressures), the NACA 0012 profile drag, the biplane of Knight and Noyes, Prandtl's best wing system, Wagner's function and blade-element momentum theory for a propeller. A complete aircraft with counter-rotating tractor propellers illustrates the use of the code.

AI.tldr: 报告介绍BBun：一个用于一个或多个相互干扰三维物体非定常势流的低阶求解器，采用涡环/分段常值偶极子、Neumann边界条件、自由涡片时间推进和隐式非定常Kutta条件，并给出数值处理、扩展及系统验证。
AI.motivation: 为多体干扰、非定常尾迹、螺旋桨/旋转体及带边界层修正的复杂构型提供高效、低阶且数值一致收敛的非定常势流分析工具，并验证其适用性。
AI.method: 物体用涡环（分段常值偶极子）离散并施加Neumann条件；尾缘及可选翼尖脱落自由涡片随时间对流，满足隐式非定常Kutta条件。为保证一致性与收敛，采用每条尾迹线单一去奇异核、奇异性Neumann问题的加边因式分解、环形物体近奇异模态的内部速度条件、由网格连通性检测分离线。还扩展到多体、盒式翼、对称构型（镜像法）、非升力体、刚性旋转体（螺旋桨）、非定常Bernoulli方程、尾迹-物体碰撞处理和展向条带积分边界层。
AI.result: 验证与确认包括：球体势流、敏感性/网格收敛、二维极限、独立涡格法对比、McAlister与Takahashi的NACA 0015机翼载荷与弦向压力、NACA 0012剖面阻力、Knight与Noyes双翼、Prandtl最佳机翼系统、Wagner函数以及螺旋桨的叶素动量理论；并用带反向旋转牵引螺旋桨的完整飞机展示代码应用。
AI.conclusion: BBun通过一致收敛的离散格式和多项工程扩展，能够有效模拟多体非定常势流、螺旋桨及完整飞机等复杂问题，且经广泛基准验证具有可靠性与实用性。

title: Thermochemically Constrained Multiscale Laplace Neural Operator to Learn Stiff Chemical Kinetics with Conditional Diffusion Model Sampling
summary: Stiff chemical kinetics is a major computational bottleneck in reacting-flow simulations, while data-driven solvers remain sensitive to training-state coverage and chemical dynamics. This work combines conditional diffusion sampling with a thermochemically constrained multiscale Laplace neural operator (TC-MLNO) for chemistry ODE integration. The diffusion model learns the equivalence-ratio-conditioned joint distribution of temperature and species from low-dimensional flame data, augmenting the state space without independent perturbations. TC-MLNO represents transient, non-periodic responses through pole-residue Laplace layers and assigns fast, medium, and slow species to separate branches. Thermochemical constraints are imposed through losses for mass and elemental conservation and heat release rate. The framework is evaluated in 1D premixed flames, a 2D developing jet, and a 3D turbulent burner flame. With equal-sized datasets, diffusion sampling reduces the 95th-percentile distance to the base flame manifold by up to 37.5% and the a posteriori full-species macro-average error by up to 92.7% versus random sampling, especially for minor species and radicals. TC-LNO yields smaller errors than the DeepONet baseline for 84.9% of retained modes and reduces the 95th-percentile error for the most attenuated modes from 0.372 to 0.081. In multidimensional flames, TC-MLNO better preserves reaction-zone locations, heat-release structures, and chemically sensitive species than DeepONet. Errors of representative radical and nitrogen-containing species in the 3D flame decrease by 88.0%-88.9%. Compared with direct CVODE integration, TC-MLNO reduces mean chemistry and total solution times by 90.1% and 62.6%, respectively. These results show that distribution-aware sampling and Laplace neural operator learning provide an accurate and efficient alternative for stiff chemical ODE integration.

AI.tldr: 该工作将条件扩散采样与热化学约束多尺度Laplace神经算子（TC-MLNO）结合，用于刚性化学ODE积分，在1D、2D和3D火焰中提升精度并显著加速。
AI.motivation: 刚性化学动力学是反应流模拟的主要计算瓶颈；数据驱动求解器对训练状态覆盖和化学动力学敏感，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 采用条件扩散模型学习以当量比为条件的温度-组分联合分布，从低维火焰数据增强状态空间且无需独立扰动；TC-MLNO通过极点-留数Laplace层表示瞬态非周期响应，并将快、中、慢组分分配到不同分支；以质量守恒、元素守恒和放热率损失施加热化学约束。
AI.result: 等量数据下，扩散采样较随机采样将使到基准火焰流形的95百分位距离最多降低37.5%，全组分后验宏平均误差最多降低92.7%，尤其利于小组分和自由基。TC-LNO在84.9%的保留模态上误差小于DeepONet，并将最衰减模态的95百分位误差从0.372降至0.081。多维火焰中，TC-MLNO比DeepONet更好地保持反应区位置、放热结构和化学敏感组分；3D火焰中代表性自由基和含氮组分误差降低88.0%-88.9%。相比直接CVODE积分，平均化学求解时间和总求解时间分别降低90.1%和62.6%。
AI.conclusion: 分布感知采样与Laplace神经算子学习为刚性化学ODE积分提供了一种准确且高效的替代方案。

title: Global-in-time Spectral Duhamel-Picard Method for Post-Exposure Bake Simulation and Physics-Informed Neural Operators for EUV Lithography
summary: We present a global-in-time spectral Duhamel-Picard method with polynomial expansions for post-exposure bake (PEB) simulation. The coupled acid-quencher reaction-diffusion equations are reformulated as nonlinear Volterra integral equations using the Duhamel principle.
